## Changes

- Increase the default watched threshold to 95%, including a one-time upgrade of the previous 85% default. Preserve other custom thresholds and existing completion rules.
- Offer Play Next for completed episodes rather than a stale Resume action, and refresh episode progress when playback history changes.
- Use in-field placeholders on TV and phone sign-in/signup forms while retaining accessible field names.
- Show only the phone tool associated with the scanned QR after validating its encrypted pairing manifest.
- Clarify that caught network request failures are not crash reports, and improve focused Diagnostics event readability.

## Verification

175 local JVM tests passed, including signed-APK verification, and all 8 phone-page tests passed. Release lint has no errors. Android instrumentation test sources compiled; physical TV and phone testing remains pending.

Signed 32-bit armeabi-v7a build for Android 8.0 and newer using the existing release key. Install over the previous version without uninstalling.
